verdict.rationale: Runloop documents a dedicated page for controlling devbox automatic shutdown and idle behaviors (runloop-docs-64). It also documents suspend/resume to save state and costs (runloop-docs-27, runloop-docs-55), and Axons that let agents suspend when idle (runloop-docs-17). The evidence is mostly page titles and summary lines, so specifics are thin. missing for 10: concrete timeout/idle parameter details, explicit confirmation that billing stops on shutdown or suspend, independent or hands-on corroboration.
